headlines.title: Average five-year mortgage rate hits 6% for first time in three years
headlines.description: The cost of a new fixed-rate mortgage has been rising in recent weeks as lenders face higher costs.

headlines.title: BT agrees rescue deal to buy broadband operator TalkTalk
headlines.description: The takeover still needs to be approved by the regulator, but would give certainty to TalkTalk's millions of customers

headlines.title: UK diesel prices top £2 a litre for first time, RAC says
headlines.description: The rise in global oil prices has been pushing up the pump prices of petrol and diesel in the UK.

headlines.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
headlines.description: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

headlines.title: US jobs market sees sharp slowdown ahead of midterm elections
headlines.description: Unemployment rose slightly as American employers paused hiring with midterm elections just a month away.
